title: ID0447861-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R0 170002837] Error during charging
description: Reported behavior/issue: I still have 2 pieces of feedback from our drivers: - LS 3, 02.09.2025, eActros, connected around 5 PM and started the charging process. By 5 AM, it had stopped at 70% (the so-called wake-up charging apparently didn't work?) - LS 3, 03.09.2025, another eActros, connected between 8 and 9 AM and there were a total of 4 interruptions. The first one after 5 minutes. Here, the driver was in a hurry, so he couldn't wait for the wake-up charging function.
